The PSNR in dB against the clean disks, for the disks with Gaussian noise of sigma 20, 22.66 dB before the filter. The image and the noise are those of the wavelet thresholding example. All columns use BayesShrink, soft thresholding, 3 levels and the estimated noise sigma. Decimated is wavelet thresholding. The stationary transform covers all 8 x 8 shifts of 3 levels. It raises the PSNR by 2.32 dB with Haar and by 1.12 dB with sym4. With 4 shifts, cycle spinning comes within 0.07 dB of it.
